title: Honey-Mustard Coleslaw with Chives
changes_from_base: A bold honey-and-mustard dressing with chives replaces most of the mayonnaise, and the cabbage is drained, not rinsed.
summary: Bold and tangy: finely shredded cabbage in a sweet honey and mustard dressing with plenty of chives.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt, for wilting (most is drained off)

steps.title: Wilt
steps.text: Toss the cabbage with the salt and sugar, put it in the colander over the bowl and leave about 1 hour, pressing now and then, until it releases its water.

steps.title: Dress
steps.text: Discard the liquid, wipe the bowl and whisk the mustard, honey, mayonnaise, chives and pepper in it.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Stir in the cabbage (not rinsed) and chill 1 hour.

tips: Squeeze the cabbage as it drains so it gives up as much water as possible.
A coarse mustard gives a great look and texture.
Serve with grilled chicken or sausages (beef or chicken).
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; stir before serving. Not suitable for freezing. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
